We're cowering in the face of voter suppression, and we refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. We're focusing all our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Driving voter participation is more critical now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help register new and lapsed voters across the country >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=36]
This was a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve. If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. Fuel our efforts with $30 to give us the resources we need to register new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=052026_3&amount=20]

Trump says Iran talks are nearly done — deal now, or another strike.

|

|

Sponsored By:
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1uwyAUxfGnwVssuNgQBoa2kbdEkVqpo8XHtYMKtgU4fv0qfYTO5-g3_L-v49WEGJb5ZhLqXKfRr36seU8bJswzlmdwdc1h3UtY0ggUxIn2J6DjEkfWeO2dN8w1qJmUigNwJpqH9mitk0Ke7QS0RzcpzrhBa6VijsqpCfpF0R4YpYz1ohVenq2xSlroGChHOmoi5tpm3HYbgzNLNeVnWrPD1q2pifpR61YIfyMwEBiO42jn_YRuTa-dwACX7i7O6pPAwJnqb-_d68mHsltG-OXr_tFk7bcjxBiKkKSjczIh_un1HzGeGn4DAAD__3mDa_Q)
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Republican Task Force Issue: 5/20/2026
Iran: Deal or Strike

Trump declared Iran nuclear negotiations are in their “final stages” on Tuesday, warning he would authorize a new [military strike](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2OozAUhZ8GOiP7AnYoXGxDl223RBf7QrzxD7JNmHn7UfIIUx4d6eh837_7ckfnXdz_YiCd67bYZJeaz3BQoLxTeTlTU3bpLC6GBThIxkcGfIl-Ea3V1lgUpiUtlJp6gF7I9qGpn6TsydhNqkFso8FeSDmuCowAceOt0-8pPoLgXIhRdtKq24rrpFYYBEymGTh6yrXLdJyrdwZjxfLcUjbUmRRarx-1HqXp_zQwNzBf19Vt6SvSVd59A7N3L2Lv3MD8QWIP9LWwgP9TZlgrmidLkbmMkZWa3ZNYPI0nzOwiPFIs7MhpzxhYwG8mpjZre1zOe1ekaga-B3T-86b-Qt5Lw08AAAD__1R0gYM) if talks collapse. Tankers began exiting the Strait of Hormuz as a precaution amid the standoff. Vice President Vance told reporters the U.S. remains “[locked and loaded](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuOqzAURb8GOiPbPAyFi9vQ5bZTosOxIWfiB7JNmPz9KPmEqbe0tdb6ui03IEdh_w_e6lS2xUSzlHT6w3qbdpufhCUmimem4BfJ5cB4zyRfgltEbbRBAwJrq4VSUytlK4b6rrEToNZ2RN6Pa2eUAhwHFJKv7TRNltek31e8l4JzIfqhGYwaV1gntcpOyAmrjoOzqTTJHufqCCEUyI8tJrQNRl87fS_lyFX7r5JzJefrupot_gR75fdeyfmIjgphruT8bdgTAlqW4ZXZx4-5iA9rmItgrGHJ5gKpME-OCqQXQ_AH0B4YJQgsnOgsJFbAPTLbgFydtDkuco7yoKqO7x7IfcjKH0I-tfwNAAD__wh6hsw)” to restart the military campaign against Iran if diplomacy stalls. Tehran’s delegation has pressed for U.S. troop withdrawals and war reparations as preconditions for any deal. Trump revealed he had come [within an hour](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGuozAQRb_GdBPZEwJLQbEN3dt2SzTYA4yesZE9Cdq_XyWf8Pqre-85f7_mL5IoaftDB49F1znkMGt5HicfXDauL_Gai-RnlXTMaLED-wC0c4qza8IYfCDnGx5d3w93xLvrmn0k79mtlkLAlVrvlnZYMAzO9ysPwYdGxneVfaCz1rlHd-tC_2uhZegXbB0O3rSWIhe9FT6fSxRPSal-r7l4vvl8NHHcVc9q7r8NTgan67puS2HRhYq-EwanM0dR8dXg9J4zONmHwckNBqcPJBR-McUKO8NFFSjBnp8F6KJ_sJZ8gBRKULXIN4PuhUk5VVhkg10UZIXEW1YhlZwqrCTR4NSUMZyXxCi1601rt4Mkfl7rDyS_RvwfAAD__y6Ij0I) of ordering a strike on Iran’s nuclear weapons program before the ceasefire pause began. Israel’s military has maintained high alert throughout the negotiations. ★★★
Senate Rebukes Trump on Iran

The Senate passed a War Powers Resolution directing President Trump to end military operations in Iran by a [50–47 vote](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDuOpDAUAE8DmZFtwDSBg03IetMNkXl-0E_rn2zTnuOPeo4wcUmlUv177k9DjsL113jUuZ67jXav-fYJPeYLy5ugxkzxLhT8LrlUjM9M8j24XfRWW7BGQI9aLMs6SjkK1b-0eoCYABauVnMgLMqqE6RSdpwRRoE96Y-Kz1JwLsSsBmWXx2GOdTnkJOQK3cSNw1yHjOk-HIEJ1ZT_Z8yAA0TfO_2qNZVu_NPJrZNba20441fAVj68k1uKjipB6eRm0RdWIGZkjQK7YmIFg6kxsxe6VJixbxMAGWUTWDOZpdgwF5axRHdXiqHP2qZGzlFRSzfxyxtyPyX1F-PeWn4HAAD__1PpgYY)—the first direct congressional rebuke of the president’s Iran campaign. Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-Louisiana, provided the decisive vote, breaking with his party just one week after [losing his Senate primary](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LuO4yAUxvGnsTsiOOFiFxTbuMu2W1qHi-OjBWMBiTVvP8o8wtTfp1_x__dYH0iJjudfzNHWvq2hhLXXVz5jjvUZ25t8L5XKq9GRV-CgGVcM-HqkVYzBBh9Q-DFaYcx8B7gLPe4WlVFy47BNM6DyUTg5aYcBvRZik2Yk-6G4AsG5EErfdDCTQzcbB1LA7AfJMcXabzWeL5fI49Gx_d9K9fHmSx6T3Xs_23D_M8AywNL3uFNKn22AZS85HvFqAyxqmjQHyRylxDy2RuGLUcWDXVjZWa5YP7ex2nBelBI1bQbJnxnpRxv7L8K8LXwHAAD__22lcsE) to a Trump-backed challenger. He was the fourth Republican to support the measure. The resolution still needs House passage to reach Trump’s desk, and the White House has [opposed legislative limits](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOszAQhJ_GdET2YjAULv6GLn97JVrsDVmdsZHthLu3PyXFPcC1o9Fovu_julyRA8ftP-5kc70tPvml5sd-0E55o_JkV1Pm9Cgc9wUkDK3sW5BLDItqvPXOo3INWWXM1AF0amjudtJ6NKMZvRxIGaTbRBp0Z6iTiHIdGravKdmDklKpfrgM3owrrpNZQSuYnNASA-V6yXQ81sAOY8XyeUvZ0cWlvQn2XutRRPdPwCxgPrHcOW41RfrCnSPlV03AHOksAuZCESsJmHVv-r7rf6OWM8b2zdyemNsjnZRL67AU9t9Ntv44OQQugxFabjtyeB-of_D1tPATAAD__ycOe3w) on its military operations against Iran. An override would require a two-thirds majority in both chambers—a threshold far beyond the 50–47 margin on Tuesday. ★★★
Trump Orders Banks: Check Citizenship

President Trump signed an executive order on Tuesday directing financial regulators to guide banks on verifying[ customers’ citizenship status](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuOpDAURL_GZG7Zl8aYwMEmZLPphsgv4Gr8QPZlRtqvX3XvH0xcqjqq8-dj-7CYsBy_bY6m0b6FGjZqd75iju2I_Qs91Yb17ljyBgIUFxMHsZW0ySGY4IOVfohGzvMyAoxSDaexQstFC6EmtctZ-6ikHJ2WAtw-6t0NaF5TYgIphJSTeqgwa2fdMjt4Slg8ewqbYqNHi9ftEnpbyPbPvTYfH77mIZmT6Ops_MVgZbDSGU9M6ZUxWM-aY4nfncFqQ8aCnZolrIXBOmmtFlA81GJT4O-33Nny2blHwr-x9BMv3snS3TnmjMf_Lo_lzc-xEIN1aCZc35gSdjWzpziyxTd_oB-o_DLwLwAA___niYX-), marking the first formal extension of immigration enforcement into the private banking sector. The order, titled [“Restoring Integrity to America’s Financial System,”](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D2PnjAQBOBfYzoj23y9FC7S0F3alGixF9jEH8heXnT_Prrr0qYeaWb0_PpYP4ACpeMnRLSF99Vnv3K544URy4H1TY5zoXxXSnE1yoxSDdKoNYVVN95650G7Bq2eprkzptNjc9quV3qY-93h5FUH4zTorncvUDhvw_waG7JfVWowWimth7Ed_fTaYJunzfTazE70CgIWbgte9xbIQWKof_ZcHLYuxybYk_mqovshzCLM8jxP-5zEeOa7YnvktzDLDo5lPRG5CrN8TQqzqOGfRF4FK3lMLH1OELz8Lb8FZMHKuWCVlBiPQvwpOUuIWMhBlTslSI4gyPpZGaMwS1Osvx4Kgeo4iV4dESh83-X_0H1b8zcAAP__umWMOA) takes aim at non-citizens who use Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers to access U.S. banking services. ITIN holders—non-citizens who lack Social Security numbers—are identified as the primary target population. The White House framed the order as a measure to combat [illicit financial activity](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDmOrDAQhk9jMpBdbE3g4CVk_dIJkbGroTRekF006tuPmCPMAf7l-76ey9OQp7j9NwF15tfikls4n-HAgHnD8ibLKVM6C8WwgIShln0Ncol-UZXTzjqjbIVajePUArRqqHbdtdA_zNqtE47to2-nDqAfhs6q1YEcbUX6rpI9KCmV6odmcONjNes0rtApmKzopPGYucl4nKsnayKb8v1K2WJjU6i83pmPItp_AmYB83VdzbUT457Ogs2W3gLmI2Mhh5HJ-NpYphSLgPneFjDLXsCcsdyAcaspMm6Z-FNzqk3ATNaU-kXRRHvny6cwBgFzlbU7LvKeyjCKTm7BkP89xX9w-NbwEwAA___fwYKM) and money laundering by non-citizens. Financial regulators will be tasked with developing compliance guidance for banks on how to screen account holders’ immigration status.
* * *

No one understands that better than me.
| **__A Letter from the Desk of Rep. Elise Stefanik__**
---
Peter,
---
President Trump has made it clear that he’ll do whatever it takes to WIN the midterms because he knows how vital our House Majority is to passing the America First agenda: _**“We must keep the Majority _at_ _all_ _costs_.”**_
---
No one understands that better than me.
---
Last year, I did what our country needed and withdrew my nomination to serve in President Trump’s cabinet to remain in the House and _protect_ our razor-thin Majority.
---
_And thank God I did. My vote was ultimately the tie-breaking vote to pass the President’s Big Beautiful Bill and grant tax cuts to millions of American families!_
---
For me, America First was never just a campaign slogan.
---
For every remaining minute that I have the honor to serve you in Congress, doing what’s right for our country will _**always**_ be my top priority.
---
**That’s why, even though I’m no longer running for reelection, I’m still committed to doing everything I can to help the President DEFEND his Majority.**
---
_Since I no longer need funds for my own campaign, I’ve decided the most effective way I can help is to use my grassroots donor network –**among the most powerful in the entire country** – to help America First Republicans WIN the key battleground races of the midterms. _
---
_After all the sacrifices I’ve made for our House Majority, you can rest assured that I’m going to spend every second I have left in Congress fighting to stop the Democrats from seizing control and DESTROYING everything we’ve fought so hard to accomplish._
---
But as we approach yet another critical fundraising deadline, I have no choice but to ask dedicated America First patriots like YOU to join me.
---

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q)_

We need to call this what it is: **this new map is a political lynching** — an affront to justice and the fight for equality. My heart aches for my hometown of Memphis, where I was born and raised and where generations of my family are buried. Don't give up hope, Peter.** The fight still carries on, renewed with urgency as we work to restore the rights that our ancestors marched, prayed, bled, and died for. [**This righteous fight for our rights has never been more important, to push back against Jim Crow 2.0, to end the corruption that runs rampant and free, to give Black and Brown People a true voice in their democracy. Our fight continues: Will you please split a donation of $10 right away between me and Blue Amp Action to stand against authoritarianism?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/12653?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.20_Pearson-Gerrymander_B5_F1_S3_C3_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q) | [CONTRIBUTE $10](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/12654?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.20_Pearson-Gerrymander_B5_F1_S3_C3_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=6&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q)

I hope that by the end of President Trump's administration and the beginning of the next Republican administration in 2028, we see zero military aid flowing from the United States to Israel.

The current 10-year U.S. military aid package to Israel, negotiated under the Obama administration in 2016, totals $38 billion and runs from fiscal year 2019 through fiscal year 2028. That comes out to roughly $3.8 billion annually.
For years, supporters of U.S. aid to Israel have correctly argued that much of that money returns to the United States through defense contracts, American jobs, weapons manufacturing, technology, pharmaceuticals, and joint security cooperation. Netanyahu himself has noted that most of the aid effectively comes back to America in the form of jobs and economic stimulus. This is true, and the ROI America receives from investing in Israel is enormous.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sUcaZIMjT1IEtkTS6Y-o4m037OI-39nPYPjX782KDFA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198637013)
But Israel's sovereignty is also at stake. Military aid creates golden handcuffs for Israel. It gives American officials leverage to tell Israel how to fight, when to stop fighting, who it is allowed to target, how it should respond to Iran, whether it can fully eradicate Hamas, whether it can neutralize Hezbollah, and whether it can destroy the Iranian nuclear threat before it is too late.
America First means we stop dictating to a sovereign nation how to run its government, its military, and its national defense. Israel should be able to bomb Iran's nuclear facilities and eliminate terrorist leaders without U.S. interference.
Once U.S. military aid to Israel ends, the Pentagon's leash comes off. Israel's wars become Israel's wars. Their foreign policy decisions become their own. And the United States will no longer have the same financial mechanism it has repeatedly used to restrain Israel from taking the military actions necessary to guarantee its survival.
Recently, I [told](https://substack.com/redirect/af2362bf-44ff-4105-8e07-1de8ec058a2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _The New York Times_ :
> _" I don't foresee the G.O.P. being as explicitly pro-Israel anymore. Whether the criticism is legitimate or not, or whether it's foreign funded or not, it's there. And perception is reality."_
I also said of the growing anti-Israel hysteria on the Right,_ "It's like a psychosis. It's literally a psychosis. It really is Israel derangement syndrome."_
That is the truth. While most conservatives still support Israel, fringe elements inside the Republican Party have become obsessed with attacking the Jewish state. They sound almost identical to the radical Left. They blame Israel for everything. They pretend Iran is not a threat. They ignore Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis, and the Islamic Republic's decades-long war against civilization.
But let's be clear. The divide inside the GOP does not even come close to the Jew-hatred and anti-Israel fanaticism that has infected the Democrat Party. Democrats march with Hamas sympathizers, call Israel an apartheid state, and demand arms embargoes against Israel while Islamic terrorists hold hostages and fire rockets at civilians. Democrats have turned anti-Israel activism into a central plank of their activist base. That is why Israel cannot allow its future to depend on American elections.
Israel cannot allow its survival to depend on whether Democrats win the White House, whether isolationists dominate the GOP, or whether online influencers decide that attacking Israel gets them more engagement and larger X payouts.
While in Israel, I visited the edge of Israel's borders with Gaza and Syria. I met survivors of the October 7 Islamic terrorist ambush who defended their kibbutz from Hamas terrorists. I met members of the IDF struggling with PTSD. I met the parents of children murdered by Hezbollah rocket attacks in the Golan Heights. I met members of the Knesset. I met family members of Druze victims of Abu Mohammed Al-Julani's violence against religious minorities in Syria.
My biggest takeaway was that Israel must become fully sovereign to guarantee its security, and the only way to do that is by ending all U.S. aid to Israel.
We cannot claim "America First" while underwriting another country's military and then allowing our own roads, border wall, election integrity systems, veterans services, and domestic infrastructure to fall apart.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sUcaZIMjT1IEtkTS6Y-o4m037OI-39nPYPjX782KDFA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198637013)
At the same time, we cannot pretend Israel is some helpless client state. Israel is a powerful, advanced, technologically sophisticated nation with one of the strongest militaries in the world. It can and should stand on its own. Cutting aid would also remove the favorite talking point of the anti-Israel Right and the antisemitic Left.
In the past, I supported U.S. aid to Israel because I believed Israel's security and America's security were inseparable. But the politics of the issue have changed. If Israel remains overly reliant on U.S. military aid, it will be restrained by the same American bureaucracy that has repeatedly empowered Iran, appeased terrorists, funded bad actors, and lectured Israel while Israeli civilians and American citizens are murdered by jihadists.
Netanyahu understands that Israel must prepare for a future where American support is no longer guaranteed. He understands that the current aid package expires in 2028. He understands that if Democrats recapture power in Washington, the drawdown may need to happen much faster than anyone expected. He knows that the best way to preserve the U.S.-Israel alliance is to make it an alliance of two strong, sovereign nations, not a relationship built on [financial dependency](https://substack.com/redirect/05e97bf3-9e6e-42e0-9b7b-7b872b85acbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and political leverage.
If you truly believe Israel has a right to exist as a sovereign state, then you should support ending all U.S. military aid to Israel.

Rep. Scott DesJarlais has been in Washington for 14 years... and somewhere along the way, something shifted.
He stopped working for the people of Tennessee's 4th District and started working for the people who keep him in power; the lobbyists, the corporate donors, and the insiders who have rigged this system in their favor for decades. **THE NUMBERS DON 'T LIE:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f6b8c673-d2eb-4845-9793-ea953ac05ed5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The GOP is bankrolling this race because they know we are coming.** 47.1% of my opponent's funds come from PACs... meaning he is answering to a whole lot of groups that ARE NOT YOU.
**[Can I count on you to chip in $15 to a campaign fueled by Americans, for Americans, built and ran by Americans?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1474c302-728f-4816-8c6d-5295c4d8d2c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ PITCH IN TODAY!!️](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1474c302-728f-4816-8c6d-5295c4d8d2c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Listen, the shift didn't happen overnight. The fundraisers replace the town halls. The donor calls replace the constituent calls and before long, they're not your representative anymore. They're Washington's man in Tennessee.
That's Scott DesJarlais today. While working families in this district are juggling two jobs just to cover rent, while small business owners are drowning in costs they can't control, while families are wondering if they'll ever get ahead, **DesJarlais is protecting the interests of the people who write him checks.**
I'm Mike Cortese, and I know what it looks like to start with nothing. I arrived in Nashville in 2001 with no car, no computer, and no connections. My wife and I built our lives from the ground up. I know what this district needs because I've lived it.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/99acbbe6-2e7f-416a-a4a9-3582cccc8cb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

This government should belong to working people again, not career politicians who have forgotten who sent them there.

Help us reach thousands of working people!

| | **Kshama Sawant is the ONLY candidate running in Washington's Ninth Congressional District with a proven track record of fighting and winning for working people!**
That's why the Democratic and Republican parties will fight tooth and nail to keep her out of Congress. And that’s why we’re building a **mass grassroots campaign to talk to tens of thousands of working people** about the importance of winning this historic race!
---
|
---
| | **JOIN US FOR OUR MAY VOLUNTEER DAY**[**THIS SATURDAY, MAY 23rd AT 11:00AM**](https://us.list-manage.com/wE0j4Da6hGx?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
[ RSVP for one of these meetup locations:](https://us.list-manage.com/j0DmB6YlC4g?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)Seattle, Columbia City - Columbia Park Renton Downtown - Jones Park
---

---
| | **Not in Seattle, or can't make it to Volunteer Day?**[**DONATE**](https://us.list-manage.com/Y5cp8wt3Hh0?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**or sign up for another**[**volunteer event!**](https://us.list-manage.com/zhwRAGjycTv?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
[**Can you donate $25, $100, or $500 now?**](https://us.list-manage.com/wUoUKBoSlyC?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| | Dear Peter,
**As you may already know, Kshama Sawant** is [on the ballot](https://us.list-manage.com/135BKmVJ95o?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) and the primary election is underway! There are less than three months until election night and we need you to help us spread the word about why **electing a proven fighter like Kshama to Congress would be a historic breakthrough for working people!**
**JOIN US** for May Volunteer Day this **Saturday, May 23 at 11am!** We will have two simultaneous meetups at different locations in the district before heading out to many different spots to talk to working people about Kshama's campaign. Join us at whichever location workers best for you:
* [Columbia Park ](https://us.list-manage.com/RX9hDAIIqVT?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)in Seattle, next to the PCC in Columbia City
* [Jones Park](https://us.list-manage.com/8BupXc5POjA?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in Downtown Renton

Please [sign up](https://us.list-manage.com/v320JTOLbZE?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) and indicate which location. We will hold a training about how to talk to working people about this campaign and get them active in this fight to elect Kshama as the first-ever revolutionary socialist to Congress. We’ll hold a short rally at each location, followed by tabling and postering to get the word out to thousands of working people about **Kshama Sawant’s independent socialist, antiwar, pro-worker campaign for Congress!**
Kshama has an unparalleled track record of winning victories for working people—like the **highest minimum wage** in the nation, the **Amazon Tax** that taxes the wealthiest businesses hundreds of millions of dollars annually to fund affordable housing, and **landmark renters’ rights** victories.
We know that big corporations and the weapons industry will spend millions to try to stop us, and it will take **an army of working class volunteers to elect Kshama to Congress!** This is your chance to get involved in the most exciting and groundbreaking campaign in the country. Whether it’s your **first time canvassing or you are a frequent volunteer** , please come out on Saturday to learn how we fight and put it into action! Snacks and water will be provided.
We’ll talk to people about how **Kshama will take the same movement-based, fighting approach in Congress as she did in Seattle** , and about the demands of our campaign:
* Free Healthcare for All — Tax the Rich
* Shut Down ICE and the Detention Centers — Stop the Deportations
* End all Military Aid to Israel — End the Genocide and Occupation of Gaza
* Stop the Data Centers and AI Layoffs — Bring Big Tech & Energy Corporations into Democratic Public Ownership
* National Rent Control & Build Millions of Affordable Homes

The incumbent in this race, Democratic Congressman Adam Smith, never met a war he didn’t like. Despite his recent rhetoric, Smith voted in December for over $906 billion for military spending, essentially writing a blank check for Trump’s wars! Adam Smith has received over $1.3 million from pro-genocide, Zionist organizations like AIPAC, and millions more will flow from the billionaires and big corporations, including the war industry. We need every volunteer and every penny to fight back against these powerful interests.
We have defeated the rich and their political servants many times before with Kshama’s leadership during her decade as the only socialist on the Seattle City Council. She has led movements of thousands of working people to victory. We have a chance once again to lead the way and hand a historic defeat to the billionaires and their political servants.
**There are still thousands of people who don’t know about this campaign and we need your help to reach them!**
See you on Saturday at 11am!
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

name: Danielle Bethell for Governor
subject: Thank You
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
Because of you, we built something real.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,Today, more than anything else, I want to say thank you.When I decided to run for Governor, I knew it would be an uphill fight. I wasn't the former statewide nominee. I wasn't the former NBA player. I wasn't the candidate who could write themself a big check or one with political infrastructure already built.I was a Marion County Commissioner, a small business owner, a mom, and a grandmother who believed Oregon needed a different kind of leadership.And because of you, we built something real.Together, we traveled across Oregon talking honestly about the challenges facing our state: rising crime, addiction, homelessness, unaffordable living costs, struggling schools, and a government that too often feels disconnected from everyday people.But we also talked about hope. About rebuilding Oregon. About what happens when leaders stop managing decline and start fighting for the people they serve.I will never forget the people I met during this campaign. The stories, the prayers, the encouragement, the conversations in small towns and living rooms and community halls across this state meant more to me than I can properly put into words.Many of you shared deeply personal stories with me. Some of you told me you saw your own struggles reflected in mine. Others said you finally felt like someone understood what ordinary Oregonians are living through right now.That trust is something I will carry with me forever.While last night's result was not what we hoped for, I remain incredibly proud of what we built together in such a short amount of time. We proved there is a growing movement of Oregonians hungry for practical leadership, honesty, grit, and leaders who understand real life outside of political circles.I also want to congratulate Senator Christine Drazan on becoming our Republican nominee for Governor. I hope Republicans, Independents, and fed-up Democrats across Oregon will unite behind her campaign as we work to defeat Tina Kotek in November. Oregon simply cannot continue down its current path.As for me, this is not the end of caring deeply about this state or fighting for the communities I love. Public service was never about a title. It has always been about people. I'll continue serving as Marion County Commissioner and fighting for a better Oregon for us all. Thank you for believing with me.
Thank you for standing with me.
Thank you for giving this campaign your time, your energy, your prayers, and your heart.If you put up a yard sign or field sign in support of this campaign, please remember to recycle it. It was truly an honor.Danielle Bethell
Marion County Commissioner**P.S.** While this campaign has ended, my time in public service has not. I'm proud to continue serving as a Marion County Commissioner. [You can follow along here](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-y/). [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-j/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-t/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-i/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-d/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-fb-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-h/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-tw-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-k/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-li-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-x/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-aujcjl-l-m)

## Trump's Candidates Dominate GOP Primaries
Trump-backed former Navy SEAL Ed Gallrein [defeated 13-year incumbent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAUhZ8Gd4zgYg92QTHRyEqzaVKktDBcr2_EjwXMWvv2kecV0h3pSEfn-_58LB-WAqXPXzaiaVteEp41YGtYllZe8XA2efK2YT0pWVtyKnkBAXcuBg5y8ZbC99J33myIgKpDI7We1KBHBd1uJqcA-kmOUkrsUd9HJUexDaPexmkVuiNzrYkBpBRCDeLm_Wrdpq0SAoZ16lkv0FPL5fY3U2o7buE7f2G5uRy7YPbWjsrUg8HMYD7P8xZrujoGMyb-qgzmC4rBfORAjdwV32y8ckw-l4oRU-PRup0S8trQxpJDqLzg8VoDOZu4p1oxNQazLfzxAPXcnz-ZmrMjz9TzxyURz_oby9EV44-TQqB616wXn9FSeN9t_-X4y8C_AAAA__9_2JIX) Rep. Thomas Massie in Kentucky's GOP primary on Tuesday, in the most expensive House primary in U.S. history at over $32 million. The president and pro-Israel groups backed Gallrein heavily after Massie voted against Trump's tax law, opposed the Iran war, and helped force the release of the Epstein files. In Georgia, [Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ugzAUxfGnMRuRuRgcBg9d2NK1I7qxr-FW_kC2myhvX6Wv0PlIP-n8v27bDTlw2j8xkmk-b4meNVBrVLZWfuJpMTl22Kg-OSGWnEreQMLcy6mHYXPI4bWpzhlPBDR2ZAatl3HS1xG6w1iUM3k3zDNqaxdFAyrnFj84p3CS947NW5MTDIOU4yQvzt3Reo2jlDDdFyWUJMctl8t35tQO8uGVH1QuNscumKO1s4rxQ8AqYG0HHRzCexOwHjnS-5CA1WI8kfckYJ2u11kp3e-Uy87YF_SeUj2p7FT6kCvV_iwcsbwErF0x7nxyCFxnLZTcI_Kf37V_BXsY-A0AAP__7D6Bag) finished third in the GOP governor's primary.
